description: Parse JavaScript whose very first line carries a flow type-checker pragma (either a single-line comment pragma or a block comment pragma at the start of the file) followed by code that is not valid plain JavaScript. The parser does not support the flow dialect, so when parsing of such a file fails it aborts with an empty program and reports exactly one diagnostic stating that this dialect is unsupported. The leading pragma is itself a comment and is still counted among the extracted comments, with its kind reflecting whether the pragma was written as a single-line or block comment.

cases.expected_output:
panicked=true
body=0
directives=0
comments=1
comment_kind=line
errors=1
error=Flow is not supported

panicked=true
body=0
directives=0
comments=1
comment_kind=block
errors=1
error=Flow is not supported
